spans.s: मोकम् [mōkam], 1 The cast-off skin of an animal; कदलीमृग- मोकानि
To be hurled or thrown upon or against.
Liberation, release, escape, freedom; सा$धुना तव बन्धे मोक्षे च प्रभवति K.;
Rescue, deliverance, delivery; ते यतध्वं परं शक्त्या सर्वे मोक्षाय पार्थिवाः

Final emancipation, deliverance of the soul from recurring births or transmigration, the last of the four ends of human existence; see अर्थ; धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां यस्यैको$पि न विद्यते । अजागलस्तनस्येव तस्य जन्म निरर्थकम् ॥;
Falling down, dropping down, falling off; वनस्थलीर्मर्मरपत्रमोक्षाः
Shedding, causing to fall down or flow; बाष्पमोक्ष, अश्रुमोक्ष.
Acquittance or discharge of an obligation (debt &c.).
(In astr.) The liberation of an eclipsed planet, the end of an eclipse.

Settling (a question).-Comp. -उपायः a means of obtaining final emancipation. -ज्ञानम् knowledge of final emancipation. -देवः an epithet applied to Hiouen Thsang, the celebrated Chinese traveller. -द्वारम् the sun. -पतिः (in music) a kind of measure. -पुरी an epithet of the town called काञ्ची. -भावः liberation. -वार्त्तिक a. reflecting upon final emancipation.
मोक्षक [mōkṣaka], a. [मोक्ष-ण्वुल्] Delivering, freeing, releasing &c. -कः A liberator, saviour, deliverer.
Releasing, liberating, emancipating, setting at liberty; यावनवध्यस्य वधे तावान् वध्यस्य मोक्षणे
Discharging, casting; शस्त्र &c. -णी The magic art of releasing any one.
मोक्षायते [mōkṣāyatē], Den. Ā. To become a means of emancipation.
Desirous of emancipation; यतयो मोक्षिण- श्चैव गृहस्थाश्चैव भारत
To release, set free, liberate, emancipate.
